settings.label: Support email
settings.info: Shown on the page as the contact for questions and reactions (US cosmetic adverse-event contact). Use a monitored address.

settings.label: Contact page address
settings.info: Customers who click Send a message go here. Create a page called Contact in Shopify admin (Online Store > Pages) and choose the template page.contact. Leave empty to hide the Send a message links.

settings.label: Logo (optional)
settings.info: Upload only images you own or have licensed. No supplier/competitor photos. Before/after only from real, consenting customers, unedited.

settings.label: Blush red (icons, large UI only)
settings.info: White text on this blush red is about 3.3:1 and fails AA for body text. Use it for icons and large shapes only.

settings.label: Blush red deep (text, buttons)
settings.info: Used for text links and buttons with white text (about 6:1).

settings.label: Butter yellow (highlights, use with ink text)

settings.content: These links fill the header menu. Leave a label empty to hide that link. If every label is empty, the store's Main menu (Online Store > Navigation) is used instead. Home page anchors work from every page.

settings.label: Link 1 address
settings.info: The word product opens your product page (the first product in your store). You can also type any address, for example /collections/all.

settings.content: Link lines are written as: Text | address. Use the word email as the address to open an email to your support address. Leave a title empty to hide that column. Only link pages that really exist, and keep every point below true for your store.

settings.label: Point 1 text
settings.default: No medicated actives. It simply covers the spot.

settings.label: Point 2 text
settings.default: Thin for the day, cushioned for the night.

settings.label: Point 4 text
settings.default: Refund if you are not happy.

settings.label: Tagline
settings.default: Day and night hydrocolloid patches for surfaced spots.

settings.label: Small badges (one per line)
settings.info: Only list things that are true and documented, for example not Dermatologist tested unless you have the proof.

settings.label: Text under the sign-up
